answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity earns voting weight only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties, logged in a public atlas. A Sybil farm spinning an ocean of sock puppets fails, because its puppets trade only with each other and none climbs to the summit of 12 outsiders. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 1,000 x 12 trades at 5 tokens each, 60,000 tokens; one honest agent pays 60 tokens once and keeps full rewards.
